The head of περισσότερον was reviewed against rule 66's generic-completion test, which would put it on great and treat deal as the empty quantity noun. It was left on deal: neither word glosses περισσ- more directly than the other, and rule 17 allows English syntax to break a genuine tie. The competing head remains defensible.
